title: Device Return Policy
content: Devices and hardware can be returned within 30 days of purchase when the serial label is intact and the device is not physically damaged. Refunds return to the original payment method after inspection.

title: Accessory Return Policy
content: Accessories can be returned within 45 days of purchase. Original packaging is preferred but not required if all parts are included.

title: Software and Subscription Returns
content: Software, digital products, and subscriptions can be refunded within 14 days only if the license or subscription has not been used. Clearance items and gift cards are final sale.

title: Shipping Timeline
content: Standard shipping usually leaves the warehouse within two business days. Tracking is published after carrier handoff. Expedited shipping leaves the warehouse the same business day when ordered before 14:00 local warehouse time.

title: Warranty Basics
content: RigAgent demo devices include a one-year limited warranty for manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover accidental damage, liquid exposure, unauthorized repair, or normal wear.

title: First Run Troubleshooting
content: If a device does not start, connect the included power adapter for at least 20 minutes, hold the power button for 10 seconds, and check the status LED. A blinking amber LED means the battery is charging.
